nodes.cisza.options.[dlug].text.t: I'm taking the shard. A debt is a debt.

nodes.cisza.options.[wola].text.t: I'm taking the shard. We'll see who hired whom.

nodes.cisza.text.t: The glass falls silent. Its surface is smooth as ice, and one shard can be taken. Everything you heard sounds like a reckoning in which you're an entry, not a party. Someone haggled over you like a sack of grain and never asked whether you agreed.

nodes.klauzule.text.t: "Clause seven: the contracting party delivers a blade that will reach the capital. Clause eight: the order of things on the ground remains untouched for as long as the pact with the local lord holds. I remind you that the people handed over to the Core as tribute are not open to negotiation."

nodes.ksiegowosc.text.t: "Destruction is your word, not mine. The blade will reach the capital. The rest is bookkeeping. Do not summon me again until you have finished counting."

nodes.straz.text.t: "To you it's tribute, to me it's an account. The wraiths are your guard, not my invention, and don't ask who told them so. I don't want to destroy this world, contracting party. I want to get out of it."

nodes.wynajem.text.t: "Your survivor is on hire, on temporary terms. The debt is not a gift but a hire, and it has an end date. Late payment will be noted."

nodes.zabieram_dlug.text.t: "A debt is a debt," you say aloud, because that's easier than admitting you have no choice. The shard cools your palm, as if someone had just signed something in your name. Maybe they have.

nodes.zabieram_wola.text.t: You tuck the shard inside your shirt as if you were hiding someone else's purse. "We'll see who hired whom," you tell the glass, and the glass, it seems, has nothing to add. For once the last word is yours.

nodes.zapis.text.t: The hollow between the shards is as quiet as the bottom of a well. When you touch the biggest piece of glass, it starts to speak, but not to you. Two voices, inhumanly calm, carry on a conversation from years ago, as if someone had told the glass to remember it in case of a lawsuit.
